articles.summary: Bridgeline Digital announced a competitive win where a U.S. B2B distributor of warehouse technology selected HawkSearch to enhance product discovery with AI-powered search capabilities. This deal reflects Bridgeline’s growing momentum in complex B2B eCommerce environments.
articles.title: Bridgeline Continues Momentum with Competitive B2B Distributor Win in Warehouse Technology Sector
Bridgeline Sees Increasing Industry Demand Through Faster Sales Cycles, Recently Closing AI Search Customer in Just 14 Days

articles.summary: Bridgeline announced today that U.S.-based plumbing and heating distributor with a large, multi-category product catalog serving contractors, installers, and design professionals has selected HawkSearch to power product discovery within its Unilog eCommerce platform.
articles.title: Bridgeline Accelerates AI Commerce Momentum with New B2B Distributor Win
Bridgeline Closes Rapid B2B eCommerce Deal in Industrial Sector as AI Search Assistant Adoption Accelerates
